PowerShell($html = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.next-impact.digital/outils/visibilite-ia" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30\).Content; $chunks = \([regex]::Matches\($html, '/_next/static/chunks/[^"]+\\.js'\) | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Select-Object -Unique\); $found = @\(\); foreach \($c in $chunks\) { try { $js = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.next-impact.digital$c" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30\).Content; $hasNews = $js.Contains\('ni:newsletter'\); $hasPrev = $js.Contains\('preventScroll'\); if \($hasNews -or $hasPrev\) { $found += "$c -> newsletter=$hasNews preventScroll=$hasPrev" }; foreach \($sub in \([regex]::Matches\($js, 'static/chunks/[A-Za-z0-9_\\-\\.]+\\.js'\) | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Select-Object -Unique\)\) { if \($chunks -notcontains "/_next/$sub"\) { $chunks += "/_next/$sub" } } } catch {} }; Write-Output "Chunks scannes : $\($chunks.Count\)"; if \($found.Count -eq 0\) { Write-Output "Aucun chunk newsletter/preventScroll trouve" } else { $found })

PowerShell($found = $false; for \($i = 1; $i -le 15; $i++\) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 60; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.next-impact.digital/en/outils/visibilite-ia" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; $chunks = \([regex]::Matches\($r.Content, '/_next/static/chunks/[^"]+\\.js'\) | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Select-Object -Unique\); foreach \($c in $chunks\) { $js = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.next-impact.digital$c" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30\).Content; if \($js.Contains\('ni:newsletter'\)\) { $p = $js.Contains\('preventScroll'\); Write-Output "essai $i : chunk $c preventScroll=$p \(cache $\($r.Headers['x-vercel-cache']\)\)"; if \($p\) { $found = $true } } } } catch { Write-Output "essai $i : erreur $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; if \($found\) { break } }; if \($found\) { Write-Output "CORRECTIF EN PRODUCTION" } else { Write-Output "TIMEOUT : la production sert toujours l ancien chunk apres 15 min - promotion manuelle requise" })
